notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1954 volume. Curated: construction contracts for the 1947 bond program's later buildings (Laurel Hill, Hamilton, Hayward, Eureka Valley, the Balboa Park stables), the move of two planned indoor pools, a memorial dedication and a playground dedication.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (payments, Camp Mather, the zoo, Kezar Stadium's press box and veterans' shelter, Aquatic Park pier and the Fort Sutter ship) not curated; the card index is too broken by OCR to read whole, so items were found by scanning the minutes for awards, dedications and namings.

findings.address_as_written: Construction of Laurel Hill P/G & Fieldhouse
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build Laurel Hill Playground and its field house to S & Q Construction Co. at $165,327, subject to funds, and asked for a further $22,997 from the 1947 recreation bond fund to cover it.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, January 28, 1954, Resolution No. 1413
